ethnicity.group: Native Hawaiian and Other Pacific Islander (non-Hispanic)

sources.name: PRRI, Census of American Religion: County-Level Data on Religious Identity and Diversity (American Values Atlas)
sources.license: Copyright PRRI; used with attribution to the published report

adapter_hint: US Census ACS (race, language, age) plus the 2020 U.S. Religion Census: python -m scripts.fetch_census.us_acs --level county
ethnicity_note: US Census race and Hispanic-origin categories (ACS table B03002). Not comparable with other countries' ethnicity classifications.
language_note: Language spoken at home, population 5 years and over (ACS table C16001).
religion_note: Summed from the 67 counties PRRI publishes, weighted by PRRI's own adult population -- the denominator its county shares are already expressed over, so this is those counties' weighted mean rather than a separate estimate. PRRI, Census of American Religion: County-Level Data on Religious Identity and Diversity (American Values Atlas). Self-reported religious identity among adults, modelled to county level from a national random sample of 40,000 adults on Ipsos's KnowledgePanel; small-area estimates rather than an enumeration, describing adults rather than all residents. Replaces the 2020 U.S. Religion Census adherent counts this unit carried, which reached about 48.6% of the population and could not distinguish the unaffiliated from the unreported. PRRI's categories cross race with religion; the Protestant and Catholic categories are summed into Protestantism and Catholicism and the racial detail is dropped rather than filed under religion.
